description: InX: an input expander that writes its own sixteen jacks into the buffer of the module it is attached to, overwriting, inserting or combining; it goes to the left of that module

params.text: Chooses what the jacks do to the buffer: Overwrite, Insert, or Add for voltages (AND for gates)

inputs.text: Feeds that channel of the buffer: overwriting it with this jack's first channel, inserting all of this jack's channels ahead of it, or adding to it — summed on voltages, ANDed on gates

notes: this module is placed to the left of the module it expands, or beside another connected input expander on that side
inserting is limited by the buffer's sixteen channels, and anything past the sixteenth is dropped
